reconverted_2026_11_07.previous_converter: act_convert.py, the 2026-11-06 converter (kept outside the repository)
reconverted_2026_11_07.why: act_convert.py dropped every Word <w:sym> character with a code of F000 or more, which is how the register writes some characters in the Symbol and Wingdings fonts, and kept Symbol-font characters typed as text as raw private-use code points (U+F0xx), which display as empty boxes. act_convert_sym.py maps them to Unicode (Symbol F0D7 ·, F0B4 ×, F02D −, F0B7 •, F0A3 ≤, F0B3 ≥ and the like) and Wingdings boxes to "[ ]".
reconverted_2026_11_07.what_changed: Only bullets. 8 Symbol F0B7 bullets that had been dropped are restored as "• " (s 173 list of ss 175-176, s 181 (3) list of ss 182-184, and the three points of the sch 1 traveller accommodation providers notice); 41 bullets kept as U+F0B7 are written as "•" (ss 4, 5 (3) examples, 71, 115, 220 and the dictionary list). No decimal point, multiplication sign, minus sign, inequality or tick box was lost. Reconverted from the same Word file (same sha256); the notice header is kept exactly and a diff against the first deposit shows no other change.
reconverted_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: none in value: baseline-2026-11 relies on ss 5, 71 and 181, whose words were intact (only the bullet glyphs changed); baseline-2026-11b relies on no changed line
